scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
Shoo, I don't need a child. Shoo! I don't talk to novices.
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究員]
走開，我不需要小孩子。走開！我不跟初心者說話。

scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
Go reach a level that can fight with stronger monsters and come back.
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究員]
去提升等級，能跟更強的魔物戰鬥了再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
Say do you like Pumpkin Pies?
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究員]
話說，你喜歡南瓜派嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
I'm a Pumpkin Hat researcher, Why don't you listen to my story?
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究員]
我是南瓜帽研究員，要不要聽聽我的故事？

scripts.text: Listen to the story.
scripts.translation: 聽故事

scripts.text: Ask about Pumpkin Hat.
scripts.translation: 詢問南瓜帽

scripts.text: Get a Pumpkin Hat.
scripts.translation: 獲取南瓜帽

scripts.text: Stop the conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
I've been studying about an upgraded Pumpkin Hat.
I have discovered that it is a very simple process.
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究員]
我一直在研究升級版的南瓜帽。
我發現這個過程非常簡單。

scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
The process is quite simple.
If you bring me ^4a4aff20 Jack o' Pumpkin^000000 I can show you.
Isn't that a tempting proposal?
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究員]
製作過程很簡單。
帶^4a4aff20個南瓜頭^000000來，我就做給你看。
怎麼樣，心動了吧？

scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
This upgraded pumpkin hat is powerful stuff!
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究員]
這頂升級版的南瓜帽非常厲害！

scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
It can make a Pumpkin Pie that restores a large percentage of HP & SP using condensed energy to the person who wears it.
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究員]
它能利用凝聚的能量，為佩戴者製作出能恢復大量HP和SP的南瓜派。

scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
All you need is ^4a4aff20 Jack o' Pumpkin^000000s.
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究員]
只需要^4a4aff20個南瓜頭^000000。

scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
Do you want to get Pumpkin Pies? Okay, let me count the Jack o' Pumpkins you've brought.
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究員]
你想獲得南瓜派嗎？好的，讓我數一下你帶來的南瓜頭。

scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
I need ^4a4aff20 Jack o' Pumpkin^000000.
I'm not an alchemist or a wizard to create something from nothing.
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究員]
我需要^4a4aff20個南瓜頭^000000。
我又不是鍊金術士或巫師，沒法無中生有。

scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
Okay, go hunting monsters and come back.
I'm going to stay here for a while so take your time.
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究員]
好，去打魔物吧，收集好再來。
我會在這裡待一陣子，不用急。

scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
I hope this will be useful to you. Don't forget to wear it while fighting to get your Pumpkin Pies.
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究員]
希望這對你有用。戰鬥時別忘了戴上它，這樣才能獲得南瓜派。

scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
I guess that I should get back to my research.
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究員]
我想我該回去繼續研究了。

scripts.text:
[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
Bye, until we'll see each other again.
I wish you well...
scripts.translation:
[南瓜帽研究員]
再見，期待下次見面。
祝你一切順利...

...
Do you want to play a trick on someone?
scripts.translation:

你想捉弄誰嗎？

I can summon monsters in other parts of the world with just a few materials.

[Halloween Wizard]
Ok then let's go to the next step.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節巫師]
好，那就繼續下一步吧。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Wizard]
How many Fabrics or Jack o' Pumpkins do you want to use? Don't go over 100 because that is the max amount that I can use.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節巫師]
你想用多少布料或南瓜頭？
最多100個，我一次只能用這麼多。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Wizard]
You have no definite idea.
It's not a big deal.
Let me know.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節巫師]
還沒想好？
沒關係，想好了告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Wizard]
I told you that it must be between 1 to 100!
You didn't pay attention!
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節巫師]
我告訴過你，必須在1到100之間！
你沒在聽嗎！

scripts.text:
[Halloween Wizard]
Recount the number of items you have and tell me the total.
Huhuhuhuhuhu...
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節巫師]
再數數你帶的物品，告訴我總數。
Huhuhuhuhuhu...

scripts.text: Theres a problem.
scripts.translation: 出問題了。

scripts.text:

Muahahaha

想想其他村子的人會是什麼反應？
Muahahaha

我會在這裡待一陣子...
